thread:
maya: AM async — pipeline + quick security asks. Two enterprise items needing eng/security eyes: Orion (HSM/KMS integration) and Helix (on-prem pilot timeline). Details below, pls ping if you need more.

ton y: noted. quick numbers: Orion is $420k ARR, Helix is $95k ARR pilot.

maya: Orion blocker — customer requires HSM-backed keywrap and a cert they can verify for FIPS/KMS. Sales needs an ETA for a test cert and a short checklist we can hand to their infra team. @jules-soc can you confirm what artifacts we can provide? :eyes:

jules-soc: I can surface SOC2 + our KMS integration doc. For HSM-specific attestation, we need eng to provide an HSM test vector and a contact for their security team. I can draft an email template.

alex: I can put together a minimal test vector. Quick q: do we expect the customer to run it locally or do we provide a signed payload they validate?

maya: they prefer running validation in their environment (air-gapped). So a signed blob + verification instructions would be ideal.

tony: Helix on-prem pilot — they want a dry-run next Thu. Need a one-page runbook for the pilot: network ports, KMS mock option, bootstrapping keys, and SLA expectations. @srini can you confirm if we have an on-prem image ready for that cadence?

srini: image exists but it's missing the keywrap CLI helper that maps to HSM. I can patch the CLI in a small PR today. Tagging the PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1423 — needs a review and a smoke test.

maya: thanks. if PR lands today, can eng provide a short smoke test we can run with the customer (non-prod)?

alex: yes — creating smoke test. will post steps here once PR is green. provisional steps:
```
# smoke test (local)
start-inference --config ./pilot-config.yaml --kms-mode mock
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
# expect 200 + token stream
```

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging image built for branch fix/keywrap-cli (sha: c3f2a7).

srini: pinging @eng-oncall for a quick review. main concerns: key persistence and cache eviction behavior under long sessions. I'll add unit tests.

tony: sales ask: can eng provide a short blurb (2-3 bullets) on limitations of mock KMS for the pilot we can include in the SOW? e.g., "mock KMS should not be used for production; no hardware attestation; performance differs from HSM-backed"

alex: yep — will draft.

maya: blocker list for today for sales: 1) HSM test vector & attest artifact (eng + soc) 2) PR review + smoke test (eng) 3) one-page pilot runbook + SOW bullets (eng + sales) 4) final pilot calendar confirmation (sales)

jules-soc: I will draft the email template and attach cert matrix today.

srini: I'll triage PR and aim for review by EOD PT. if reviewers slow, I'll merge behind a feature flag for the pilot.

maya: perfect. please ping here when any of the four items are done. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
